consequence.statement: New feature: mTLS support for Memcached connections is added; the text states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: Loki adds mTLS support for Memcached connections.

decision.reason: [ev-698bdca68108] lists "Memcached: Add mTLS support" under 3.0.0 Features. It describes a new capability being added and says nothing that fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. So "none" (informational) is the supported consequence for an environment that does nothing. Confidence is low because "no consequence" is inferred from the change being purely additive, not stated outright.
